seg_recast.other_seg_label: Asphalt mix and Concrete (combined reporting segment)
seg_recast.notes: Recast from FY2008 10-K Note 15 / Item 1 segment table (three reportable segments: Aggregates; Asphalt mix and Concrete; Cement). The FY2008 10-K does NOT split Asphalt mix and Concrete (they are combined into one reporting segment), so the combined segment is in other_seg_* (other_seg_dda=14.1 added key) and asph_*/conc_* revenue/GP are null. Segment revenues include intersegment sales; per-segment intersegment split not disclosed for 2006 (total -125.3). The FY2007 10-K Ex.13 shows 2006 on a net-of-intersegment basis: Aggregates 2,280.2, Asphalt mix and Concrete 760.9 (same GP/DDA). DDA 226.4 and GP 931.9 reflect the FY2007 retrospective FSP AUG AIR-1 restatement (original: DDA 224.7, GP 932.0). Capex by segment (FY2007/08 10-K): Aggregates 425.5, Asphalt mix & Concrete 30.6, Corporate 2.8.
